_note: #278. Provenance lines count only in a review's header: the first run of non-blank lines under its title, quoted lines left out. l-new and m-new are current and carry a Supersedes: line below the header (l-new's inside a quoted block): l-old and m-old stay stale. quoted-only has Reviewed: and Version line: only in a quoted block lower down. quoted-header and listed-quote quote the Reviewed: line inside the header. no-title has no title line and late-title has text above it: neither has a header. after-blank puts a blank line before Version line:. marked writes its header with list marks and bold: no finding. A finding prints at most 120 characters of a value copied from a review, and matches on the whole value: long-ok quotes a 292-character line of its document in full and has no finding; long-version differs from that line only in its last two characters and is stale; long-path and long-supersedes name a path about 290 characters long. control's version line carries an escape, a bidi override and a zero-width space: none is printed. `details` pins each cut. long-stale-path and long-other name a document that exists by a path 133 characters long: the stale finding and the wrong-document finding cut it too. control's finding says hidden characters were left out. bom starts with a byte-order mark and has no finding. n-new has a line of zero-width spaces where the blank line would be, then a Supersedes: line: the header ends there, and n-old stays stale.
